description: Integration test class for testing Buy Down Fee functionalities within progressive loans using JUnit 5. Contains setup, multiple test cases for creating, adjusting, reversing buy down fees, and verifying related accounting entries and business events.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeTest
classes.description: JUnit integration test class for buy down fee functionality on loans in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, enabling business events and initializing test data.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Static method to disable external events after all tests have run.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeOnProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Test creating a buy down fee on a progressive loan and verifying its presence.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeWithNote
methods.description: Test adding a buy down fee with an external note and verifying transaction details.

methods.name: testMultipleBuyDownFees
methods.description: Test adding multiple buy down fee transactions and verifying their existence.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeAccountingEntries
methods.description: Verify the accounting journal entries created for a buy down fee transaction.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeValidation
methods.description: Validate error handling for invalid buy down fee amounts (negative or zero).

methods.name: createProgressiveLoanProductWithBuyDownFee
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with buy down fee enabled and specific accounting settings.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeAdjustment
methods.description: Test creating an adjustment to a buy down fee and checking transaction records.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeAdjustmentValidations
methods.description: Validation tests for buy down fee adjustments (exceeding original, date validations).

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeAdjustmentAccountingEntries
methods.description: Check correct accounting entries after buy down fee adjustments.

methods.name: testMultipleBuyDownFeeAdjustments
methods.description: Test multiple adjustments to a buy down fee for a loan.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeAdjustmentWithExternalId
methods.description: Create a buy down fee adjustment with an external ID and verify transaction details.

methods.name: addBuyDownFeeForLoan
methods.description: Helper function to create a buy down fee transaction for a loan.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeDailyAmortization
methods.description: Test amortization of buy down fee on a loan with daily schedule and verify transactions.

methods.name: testRetrieveBuyDownFeeAmortizationDetails
methods.description: Test fetching amortization details for buy down fees on a progressive loan.

methods.name: testRetrieveBuyDownFeeAmortizationDetails_notEnabled
methods.description: Verify failure when attempting to fetch amortization details when feature is disabled.

methods.name: tesReverseBuyDownFeeTransactionWithAmortizationAdjustmentTransaction
methods.description: Test reversing a buy down fee transaction that has an amortization adjustment linked.

methods.name: testReverseBuyDownFeeTransactionWithoutAmortizationAdjustmentTransaction
methods.description: Test reversing a buy down fee transaction without associated amortization adjustment.

methods.name: testReverseBuyDownFeeTransaction
methods.description: Test reversing a buy down fee transaction and verifying journal entries and transactions.

methods.name: testTryToReverseBuyDownFeeTransactionWithBuyDownFeeAdjustment
methods.description: Test that reversing a buy down fee linked to an adjustment fails as expected.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeForNonMerchant
methods.description: Test buy down fee process when merchantBuyDownFee is false, verifying different accounting entries.

methods.name: testBuyDownFeeWithAdvanceAccountingMappings
methods.description: Test creating a loan with custom classification and income accounts, verifying ledgers after buy down fee and amortization.
